task_description: Write a method in Dafny to check whether any value in a sequence exists in a sequence or not.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ExistsInSequence(seq1: seq<int>, seq2: seq<int>) returns (result: bool)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - If the method returns true, then there exists at least one value that appears in both sequences
- If the method returns false, then no value in seq1 exists in seq2
